503.description: The Health Check is not successful

message.description: For people. Never parse it; branch on `code`.

param.description: The request field that caused the error.

request_id.description: The x-request-id of the request; quote it when reporting a problem.

details.description: Extra data for the code; its shape per code is in ErrorDetailsByCode.

ErrorDetailsByCode.description: Each error code's `details` shape, keyed by code. A code that isn't listed has no fixed shape.

fields.description: Every failing field; nested properties as dotted paths.
